supportedRegions.notes: Requires Linux Functions custom container support, Storage, Application Insights, Flexible Server PostgreSQL, and Key Vault support in the selected region.

requiredPermissions: Provision and mutate App Service plans, Linux Function Apps, deployment slots, Storage, and Application Insights
Provision Flexible Server PostgreSQL, optional Azure Cache for Redis, Key Vault secrets, and storage accounts/containers
Assign AcrPull and runtime access roles when private registries or managed identities are used

upgradePath.strategy: Image update with optional deployment-slot promotion
upgradePath.rollback: Republish the prior image or swap back from the staging slot
